title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Phrase enters
scenes.purpose: Read the phrase in order. Each word gets its own typographic move on a measured baseline grid, then the whole phrase holds before anything becomes structure.
visuals: Stationary night forest-green ground #102820 with one soft deterministic radial light and a faint drafting grid
Cream #F4E9D5 type; the amber #F2B544 accent is kept for the word 'system.' and, later, the load-bearing T
'CONNECTED' enters at weight 300, tracked to fill the full margin width, over a hairline rule
Amber 'system.' rises onto its platform rule

beats.development: 'an', then 'idea', enter with different eases and durations
'BECOMES' tracks open. 'CONNECTED' and its hairline arrive, then 'system.' lands on its platform. The full phrase holds from 1.12 s.

scenes.title: Key word becomes a lintel
scenes.purpose: Architectural typography recipe: the key word gains weight, and its T becomes the lintel and support that carry the earlier words.
visuals: 'CONNECTED' re-weights from 300 to 900 while its tracking tightens, so its width and counters are kept
At 1.55 s the DOM 'T' is swapped for its measured SVG outline at identical geometry
MorphSVGPlugin deforms only the T crossbar: it widens into a lintel whose tips flex up, then it settles straight
The T stem lengthens as the support; the T fills from cream to the amber structural accent
'BECOMES', 'idea' (the load, centred over the support) and 'an' travel onto the lintel with x/y transforms, changing size, weight and tracking
The clear band between the lintel and the cap height of CONNECTED remains as the aperture

beats.development: CONNECTED re-weights and changes tracking at constant width
The T crossbar morphs into the lintel and turns amber, the stem rises, and the earlier words build the line 'an idea BECOMES' on top

scenes.title: Final composition holds
scenes.purpose: A settled, readable structure built from the earlier words, plus the tagline.
visuals: Tagline lines enter at the lower left

beats.development: The two tagline lines land on separate beats, then the full composition holds

findings: The phrase is complete by 1.12 s, so it holds before the re-weight at 1.2 s
The lintel morph, stem and word travel finish by 2.18 s; the tagline finishes by 2.6 s, before the 2.7 s settle limit
Beats are contiguous and do not overlap
justifiedHolds: 0.08 s hold on the complete phrase before it turns into structure
0.4 s final hold on the completed structure and tagline

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or lyrics

Recipe demonstrated: architectural_type. Glyph roles: lintel (T crossbar, the only path MorphSVG deforms), support (T stem), load ('idea' over the stem), aperture (clear band above CONNECTED), platform (rule under 'system.')

Source-frame refresh: the background policy is scene_dependent, so the earlier cream swatch was replaced. The recipe source palette (#102820 / #F4E9D5 / #F2B544) is adopted explicitly, matching the forest-green-with-amber option in BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json

Lessons taken from the reviewed contact sheets: a three-role colour split (quiet ground, high-contrast neutral type, rare accent), one stationary radial light, a faint grid as the only texture, and reading holds between developments. No source subject, wording or branding is copied
Contrast: cream on ground 12.97:1, amber on ground 8.52:1, cream over the brightest point of the glow 10.56:1
Word travel uses GSAP x/y transforms from static CSS anchors; left and top are never tweened
